text: You should know I ain't gonna miss you when you go down so long I've been tossed around, no Couldn't you just let me go down and do my stuff? I know you're hoping to find someone who's gonna be a piece of mine When times go bad, when times go rough Won't you let me down in tall grass and let me do my stuff?
